Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 11 June 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Laguna, Rizal, Quezon and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose, Mayantoc, Camiling, San Clemente), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Tuy, Calaca), Cavite(Ternate, Naic, Tanza, Magallanes, Maragondon, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Alfonso) and Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Pulilan, Paombong, Baliuag) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.

[4:43PM] #IkoyiObalende #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along the Awolowo Road corridor, both inbound and outbound, extending to Onikan Roundabout, is currently flowing smoothly.
However, commuters should anticipate moderate congestion in the Falomo area. Specifically, the inbound lanes of Boudillion Road, the Alexandre Road link bridge, and Alexandre Roundabout towards Gerrard Roundabout are experiencing increased traffic volume due to the evening rush hour.

Alfred Rewane Road, particularly the stretch near the Registry and NNPC heading towards Golden Gate, is also experiencing some congestion, primarily attributed to alternation. 
Conversely, traffic movement remains good from Golden Gate, intersecting with Bayo Kuku Road and continuing inbound towards Osborne Foreshore. This favorable flow extends across Dolphin Bridge into Ilubirin and onto the Third Mainland Bridge at this time.

Finally, the Obalende Bridge and its immediate surroundings are currently reporting smooth traffic conditions.
No immediate road impediments have been observed, and our officers are present to manage the flow as needed.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:51PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic flow descending from CMS Bridge towards Offin Canal is currently slow due to ongoing market activities and a high volume of pedestrian. However, immediately after the Offin Canal, the movement towards Eko Bridge by the NEPA office is good.

On Eko Bridge, traffic flow from the NEPA area heading towards CMS Bridge is smooth.
Vehicular movement descending Eko Bridge towards Elegbeta Mini Stadium and Ebute-Ero Market is presently good.

Commuters descending from Carter Bridge towards Ebute-Ero Market and continuing along Leventis through UBA Roundabout to connect both inner and outer Marina is also experiencing good traffic flow.

There is currently slow movement reported on Broad Street, extending to Apongbon underneath the bridge, where it connects to the Offin Canal market area.
At this time, no traffic impediments have been reported, and personnel are on ground to manage traffic situation effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
